newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Paliburg proposes bonus issue of warrant.
newsitem.headline: Paliburg proposes bonus issue of warrant.

text.p: Property development concern Paliburg Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it proposed a one-for-four bonus warrants issue.

Assuming that its proposed bonus issue of shares is approved, all holders of the 1997 warrants and 1998 warrants of the company will, under the terms of the warrant instruments, be entitled to an additional 1997 warrant for every four existing 1997 warrants and one additional 1998 warrant for every four existing 1998 warrants held, it said.
The subscription prices for the 1997 and 1998 warrants will also be accordingly adjusted to HK$16 per share and HK$7.2 per share respectively.
The terms of the 1997 and 1998 bonus warrants are the same as the terms of the existing 1997 and 1998 warrants.
The company earlier proposed a bonus issue of one-for-four shares held.
